answer.book: A single Latin theological dissertation, 'De Socino et Socinianismo', by Geo. Ashwell (Oxford, 1680), built as a dedicatory epistle, a preface to the reader, an argument summary, a long body under the running head 'De sana, sive recta Ratione', and closing index of chapters and errata.
